by_month.description: Event counts per month for the filtered states (ignores the month filter)

intensity_global.description: value / busiest state-month overall (0-1): absolute volume

intensity_row.description: value / the state's own busiest month (0-1): seasonal shape
intensity_row.title: Intensity Row

figures.description: Display strings the sentence is allowed to use

color_bucket.description: 1-10 for the top 10 (1 = highest), else null

yoy_change.description: % change vs previous year (percentage points for growth_pct)

data_sources.title: Data Sources

synthetic_share.description: Percentage (0-100) of returned values that are synthetic
synthetic_share.title: Synthetic Share

max_value.description: Largest value across frames, for a fixed axis
max_value.title: Max Value

rank.description: Rank within the filtered scope (1 = highest value)
rank.title: Rank

share_pct.description: Share of the scope total (additive metrics only)
share_pct.title: Share Pct
